review: Read complete device connection and download pages, both test suites and unchanged Google sign-in component. Selected first-party source and synthetic HTTP/credential fixtures only; no live account data or third-party assets.

Device connection now offers independently selected text and voice installation permission. Both default false and require server availability. Approval does not start a model run, microphone, paid session, room consent, agent pairing or game action.

Corrected three stale exact-body expectations and added three independent voice/text consent combinations, including clearing voice after selection. All calls are mocked and unexpected endpoints throw.

Download page adds the getting-started guide and supported public-source overview links. Native callers still use the in-app updater and suppress public installer lookup; schema and server approval remain separate dependencies.

The unchanged Google sign-in component remains separately dependent on Google Identity Services and server credential validation. These tests mock that component and do not qualify live authentication.
limits: Private unfrozen source candidate only; no publication, sign-in, paid request or native restart.
Agent Access page remains held with its unreviewed 1805-line SetupContractInbox dependency. Account portal and private enrollment/billing components remain separate open review.
Canonical shared contracts and omitted client helpers remain separate dependencies; this preview is not a standalone app.
Mocked tests do not qualify deployed paid voice, installed updates or the attended Minecraft/GPT Live handoff.
